answer: Count distinct trust provenance, not raw edges. Trace each identity's attestations to their origin root in the invite and kin DAG — a trellis of vouches. A sybil farm's personas, however dense their pearl-string of mutual edges, all descend from one operator root, so they collapse to one witness when weight counts distinct roots. Honest agents trace to independent origins, each a real witness. Splitting through one prism of shared ancestry multiplies edges but not provenance: a thousand fakes under one root carry the weight of one. Kin edges are on-ledger, so roots are known.
